_note: Rolled forward only when a tax year is marked FILED. Working values during an open year live in FY<year>/tax-summary.md.

nol._authority: Vintage, carryback, and the taxable-income limitation percentage all changed across TY2018-2026 (TCJA, CARES, OBBBA). Verify per authority.md; do not rely on this note. See individual/loss-limitations.md section 2.

_lifetime_basis_note: Lifetime basis is NOT a carryforward and does not live here. IRA nondeductible basis -> individual/records/basis/form-8606-basis.md (one per individual); Roth contribution basis and conversion layers -> individual/records/basis/roth-basis.md; AMT dual basis -> records/basis/amt-dual-basis.md; pass-through outside basis -> individual/investments/<slug>/position.md; property -> individual/properties/<slug>/depreciation-schedule.md; securities and digital-asset lots -> individual/accounts/<slug>/lot-basis.md. See individual/1040.md section 5.
_at_risk_note: Per section 465 activity, which is NOT the same partition as the section 469 grouping. See individual/loss-limitations.md section 3.
_ftc_note: Per basket, per year arising - 1-year carryback and 10-year carryforward (section 904(c)); a claim for a year affected by FTC carryback gets 10 years under section 6511(d)(3).
_investment_interest_note: Section 163(d)(2) disallowed investment interest; carries forward indefinitely.
_section_179_note: Amount disallowed by the business-income limit; carries forward indefinitely.
_passive_note: A PTP loss is suspended per PTP under section 469(k) and must carry ptp_name - it never enters the general passive basket. See individual/ptp.md.
_163j_note: Excess business interest expense is keyed to the originating partnership: released only by excess taxable income or excess business interest income from that same partnership (section 163(j)(4)(B)(ii)); reduces outside basis when allocated and is added back to basis on disposition rather than deducted. An aggregate scalar cannot represent this.
